intro.title: The Delta Sphere
intro.plays: Before castle1, after the Warp Portal at the end of 1-10
intro.synopsis: Through the Warp Portal, Gyroid and Emmy come out at the edge of Chain Delta. Null's sphere stands in the water, loops crawling over it and shrinking to points. Gyroid sprints the causeway and rides the meridian lift up the sphere's curve to its flattened pole, where Null waits under the Crown and promises three trials, with the Delta as the stake.

scenes.title: The Delta
scenes.description: Out of the Warp Portal onto a causeway; the pale sphere stands in the delta, golden loops crawling over it and shrinking to points.

scenes.title: The causeway
scenes.description: Gyroid sprints the causeway; Emmy stays at the portal.

scenes.title: The meridian lift
scenes.description: A disk of light carries him up a golden meridian rail, round the sphere's bulge to its flattened top.

scenes.title: The court
scenes.description: The court on the pole: an engraved floor, meridian ribs curling up, Null before his throne with the Crown above.

scenes.title: Three trials
scenes.description: Three sigils light in the floor; Crown shards begin to orbit.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card: World 1 · Castle — The Delta Sphere.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Past the Bastion's north gate, the roads ran out into the Delta. And in the Delta stood Null's sphere.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Look at the loops on it, Gyroid. Every one he draws slides off and shrinks to nothing.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Where my number can't follow.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Gyroid. You gave Haven back its hole. Emmy must be so proud of you.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: But this is my sphere. Here, every loop comes home to nothing.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Three trials, Gyroid. Fail one, and the Crown takes the Delta. Gently.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Not this time.

outro.title: Your Number Reads Zero
outro.plays: After castle1 — the end of World 1, into World 2
outro.synopsis: Null flings Gyroid off the citadel and raises the whole Delta Sphere out of the water. Gyroid throws his winding loop round it; it slides off and shrinks to a point, twice, and the reading is zero: on a sphere every loop shrinks, so π₁ cannot prove the hollow is there. The Crown folds the Delta Sphere to a point in front of them. Null taunts and escapes into the Delta. At dusk Emmy names what they need: a count that sees what a surface encloses, higher holes. Homology.

scenes.title: Flung out
scenes.description: A violet flash; Gyroid lands on the causeway. Emmy runs to him.

scenes.title: The sphere rises
scenes.description: Null, on the court's rim, raises the whole Delta Sphere out of the water, villages lit, water streaming.

scenes.title: Zero
scenes.description: Gyroid throws his winding loop round the sphere: it slides off and shrinks to a point. Again. The gauge reads 0.

scenes.title: The Crown
scenes.description: Null steps off onto a ribbon of light and turns the Crown's beam on the sphere.

scenes.title: The fold
scenes.description: The lights go out one by one; the sphere turns violet, flattens to a disk, shrinks to a point that hangs, then a flash. A violet whirl on empty water.

scenes.title: Horror
scenes.description: Gyroid, staring at the empty water; Emmy beside him.

scenes.title: The taunt
scenes.description: Null, hovering, taunts them, then races away into the Delta on his ribbon.

scenes.title: Resolve
scenes.description: Dusk on the causeway; triangle-tiled flats glint across the Delta. A count that sees higher holes.

scenes.title: World 1 complete
scenes.description: Card: World 1 complete · Bouquet Bastion on the Chart.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Crown flung Gyroid off the citadel, down onto the causeway.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: I'm fine. I'm fine. Where is he?

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Here, Gyroid. The Delta Sphere: ten thousand lights. It looks hollow, doesn't it? Prove it has a hole.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: One loop, right round it. Count it… It slides. It's sliding off!

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Try another way round!

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Zero. It reads zero. Every loop shrinks.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Then there is nothing here for my Crown to spare.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Delta Sphere went dark. Every light on it, every road across it.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: A sphere became a disk. A disk became a point.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: No. No! I counted! I counted, and it still came out zero!

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Your count didn't fail, Gyroid. It can't see this kind of hole.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Your number reads zero, Gyroid.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Then no hole at all. Sleep well.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: And Count Null was gone, deep into the Delta.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: A loop can't wind round a hollow. We need a count that sees what a surface wraps around.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Then we count that. Every triangle in this delta if we have to. And the sphere goes back on the Chart.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Homology. Down into the Delta.
